Application Data.NAME: Artistry in Action Studio
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art Lane, Suite 100, Creative City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artistry in Action Studio provides a creative space for artists to explore and develop their craft through various mediums, including painting, drawing, digital art, and textile crafts. Our studio focuses on non-hazardous artistic activities, utilizing non-toxic materials that are stored safely. We offer public workshops and classes, adhering to comprehensive safety protocols, including proper ventilation and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Our facility is equipped with fire detection and suppression systems, ensuring a safe environment for both artists and visitors. Additionally, we maintain secure inventory management for our materials and completed artworks, emphasizing reliable fulfillment processes and data security for our online sales.
